name: Iron Coral
summary: In Tinker Town, Klockmort Spannerspan seeks searing coral for a new suit of armor. The gnome blacksmith hopes to test new smithing methods with this rare sea material on the Wetlands coast.

sections.title: A Fusion of Crafts
sections.body: Klockmort Spannerspan has shared discoveries with Furen Longbeard, a master dwarven smith. Now he hopes to unite Furen's skill in metallurgy with his own tinkering. Mountain ore alone will not give him the resilient armor he seeks. So he needs searing coral, a material hardened by the sea.

sections.title: Diving the Wetlands Shore
sections.body: Searing coral grows underwater off the Wetlands coast, south of Menethil Harbor. You need to bring back twenty clusters while aquatic predators prowl below. Then carry the harvest to Ironforge. Klockmort plans to smelt and hammer the coral into experimental armor plating.

faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan is a skilled gnome blacksmith in Tinker Town, Ironforge. He loves mechanical tinkering and new approaches to metallurgy, and works with dwarven artisans on armor-making methods.

aliases: what is searing coral used for
faq.answer: Searing coral is a rare ocean growth on the seabed south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. An inventive smith can smelt and hammer it into armor reinforcement because of its unusual chemical and physical qualities.

faq.q: Where do I find the searing coral?
faq.answer: Search underwater along the Wetlands coast south of Menethil Harbor. Divers must pry the mineral-rich branches loose from the seabed.

faq.q: Why does Klockmort need searing coral instead of metal ore?
faq.answer: Klockmort hopes searing coral will make armor lighter and more durable than armor made from Ironforge ore alone. He is adapting smithing techniques learned from the dwarf Furen Longbeard.

faq.q: How is Furen Longbeard involved in this task?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard developed new armor-crafting techniques with your help. Grateful for your aid, he shared his trade secrets with Klockmort, inspiring the gnome's protective designs.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the coral to Klockmort?
faq.answer: With twenty loads of searing coral, Klockmort begins smelting and hammering it at his workbench. His work leads to experimental gear in Klockmort's Creation.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Klockmort's search for strange coastal minerals as a way to improve traditional craft through experiment.
As a dwarf, you can see master smith Furen Longbeard's metallurgic discoveries at work in this collaboration between gnomes and dwarves in Tinker Town.
As a blacksmith, you can appreciate Klockmort's attempt to smelt an ocean deposit into hardened armor plating.
As an engineer, you can recognize the value of testing unusual materials to make better protection.
